title: Ancestral Beard Set - 1 of each
description:
Everything you need for a well-groomed, well-nourished beard. One oil, one brush, both made with natural materials and built for daily use.

A proper beard routine does not need to be complicated. It needs the right oil and the right brush - used consistently, daily. This set gives you both.

The Beard Oil nourishes the beard and the skin beneath it, conditions the hair from root to tip, and leaves a clean, natural scent. The Boar Bristle Brush distributes the oil evenly through the beard, stimulates the skin underneath, and trains the hair to lie in a consistent direction over time. Together they work better than either does alone.

What’s included in the Beard Set:

1 x Ancestral Beard Oil

A blend of six ancestral oils and five pure essential oils, formulated to condition the beard and support the skin beneath it.

Jojoba forms the base - a liquid wax ester that closely mimics the skin’s natural sebum, absorbing cleanly without residue. Meadowfoam Seed Oil locks in moisture throughout the day. Castor Oil adds body and healthy shine to the hair shaft. Argan Oil delivers deep nourishment through vitamins A and E and natural antioxidants. Black Seed Oil provides anti-inflammatory support for the skin beneath the beard. Vitamin E completes the blend as a natural antioxidant.

The essential oil blend - Basil, Patchouli, Siberian Fir, Clary Sage, and Peppermint - gives the oil a grounded, natural scent. No synthetic fragrance.

1 x Ancestral Beard Brush 

A beard brush made from natural boar bristle and solid walnut wood.

Boar bristle has a structure close to human hair, which allows it to condition as it brushes - picking up natural oils from the root and distributing them along the full length of the hair shaft. No synthetic fibres, no plastic.

The walnut wood handle is dense, smooth, and balanced for daily use.

title: Ancestral Beard Brush - 1 pack
description:
A beard brush made the way it always was - boar bristle, walnut wood, nothing synthetic.

Built for daily use and made to last.

A good beard brush does a few things well: it distributes oil evenly through the beard, lifts and separates the hair, stimulates the skin beneath, and helps train the beard to grow in a consistent direction over time.

The bristles are natural boar bristle - a material with a structure close to human hair, which is why it conditions as it brushes. As it moves through the beard it picks up the natural oils from the root and distributes them along the full length of the hair shaft. No synthetic fibres means no static, no snagging, and nothing artificial making contact with your skin every day.

The handle is walnut wood - dense, smooth, and comfortable to hold. No plastic, no rubber grips. Just solid wood that feels better in the hand the more you use it.

title: Ancestral Beard Oil - 1 pack
description:
A nourishing blend of ancestral oils and pure essential oils - crafted to condition the beard, soften the skin underneath, and make daily grooming something worth looking forward to.

This is a beard oil built around one idea: every ingredient earns its place. 

Each oil in this blend has been used on skin and hair for hundreds, in some cases thousands, of years.

Short ingredient list, clear sourcing. Carefully chosen set of oils that work well together and absorb cleanly without residue for easy daily use on all types of beards.

Golden Jojoba Oil forms the base - a liquid wax ester that closely mimics the skin’s natural sebum, conditioning both beard hair and the skin beneath without clogging pores.

Meadowfoam Oil adds lasting moisture retention, keeping the skin and hair nourished throughout the day.

Castor Oil lends body and definition to the beard, coating the hair shaft for a healthy, full appearance.

Argan Oil brings deep nourishment through vitamins A and E, antioxidants, and fatty acids that soften coarse hair and support the skin underneath.

Black Seed Oil rounds out the blend with calming, anti-inflammatory properties for the skin beneath the beard that often gets overlooked.

The essential oil blend - Basil, Patchouli, Siberian Fir, Clary Sage, and Peppermint - gives this oil a grounded, natural and masculine scent. Earthy, fresh, and clean. 

Size: 30ml (1 oz)

Our Dry Body Oil is a lightweight blend of nourishing oils created to keep the skin soft, smooth and comfortable every day.

The formula absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling silky and nourished with a clean, dry finish. It is formulated to become an easy daily ritual, something you reach for after a shower or anytime your skin needs a little extra care.

This oil is light and spreadable,  leaves the skin feeling nourished and silky, with a light glow. You can apply it after your shower and put your clothes on right away. Perfect for summer nights out.

  • Argan oil adds deep ancestral nourishment with naturally occurring fatty acids that support soft and smooth skin.

Dry Body Oil carries the same scent as our signature Tallow Body Cream - elegant blend of Bergamot, Vanilla and Jasmine. The result is a luxurious, comforting and slightly addictive scent. 

Dry Body Oil was formulated to work beautifully together with our Tallow Body Cream.

Used on its own, it provides lightweight nourishment and leaves the skin soft and comfortable. For deeper nourishment, the two can be layered together.

title: Tallow & Honey Lipbalm (Combo Pack) - 1 of each
description:
BUNDLE CONTAINS:

  • 1 of each: One Peppermint Lip Balm, One Orange Lip Balm, One Vanilla Lip Balm
  • 2 of each: Two Peppermint Lip Balms, Two Orange Lip Balms, Two Vanilla Lip Balms
  • 3 of each: Three Peppermint Lip Balms, Three Orange Lip Balms, Three Vanilla Lip Balms

Unlike the rest of our skin which has a thick protective layer, our lips are more prone to dryness, absorbing everything you put on them and withstanding harsh weather conditions. That's why they require highly effective moisturisers and protectants.

Our long-lasting Tallow & Honey Lipbalm is a deeply moisturising, nourishing and repairing balm that seals moisture and keeps your lips protected the entire day.

Beef tallow is the most effective natural moisturiser and that makes it perfect to use on your lips.

Due to our special melting process and formulation, you don't have to fear beefy smell.

Our lip balm contains all-natural & minimally processed ingredients:

  • Grass-fed, pasture-raised Irish beef tallow, sourced locally from Irish farms
  • Locally sourced raw Irish honey
  • Natural unrefined beeswax
  • Pure essential oils of Peppermint, Orange or Vanilla
  • Handmade in Ireland in small batches

title: Tallow Deodorant: Velvet Dust - 1 pack
description:
Reliable odour control, zero irritation, a smooth glide, and a gentle winter scent that feels natural and wearable.

A natural deodorant that actually works.

Comfortable on sensitive skin, reliable through winter layers, and scented to match the body cream with a slightly deeper base.

KEY BENEFITS:

  • Long lasting odour control
  • No irritation
  • Smooth application
  • Clean, refined winter scent
  • Aluminium free and baking soda free

SCENT PROFILE:

Smells like: Winter air wrapped in silk, powdery and refined.

  • Top notes: Lavender and Jasmine Grandiflorum
  • Mid notes: Orris and Vanilla
  • Base notes: Labdanum and Benzoin

MADE WITH:

  • Grass-fed & finished, Pasture-Raised Irish Beef Tallow, Cocoa Butter and Castor Oil base for nourished & hydrated armpits
  • Magnesium Hydroxide to neutralise odour-causing bacteria & Arrowroot Powder to keep your armpits dry
  • A blend of 100% Pure Essential Oils for amazing-smelling armpits

Ancestral Cosmetics Tallow Deodorant is our answer to all commercial deodorants out there. With our deodorant, it is time to regain our armpit health once and for all.

Our Tallow Deodorant is formulated with ingredients rooted in ancestral wisdom but powerful enough to offer odour protection in the modern day. Simple but effective ingredients that actually work!

Our simple but powerful formula works by neutralising bacteria that are the main cause of body odour. Gentle ingredients like magnesium hydroxide and non-nano zinc oxide neutralise bacteria that are causing body odour while arrowroot powder helps to absorb the sweat instead of stopping the body from sweating.

Grass-fed & finished, Pasture-Raised Irish beef tallow, organic cocoa butter and organic castor oil in our simple base make sure that deodorant is gentle and nourishing for the skin. A blend of 100% pure organic essential oils provides amazing-smelling pits all day long.

Ancestral Cosmetics Tallow Deodorant does NOT contain aluminium, artificial fragrances, refined seed oils, and petroleum-based ingredients. We never use harsh additives or cheap fillers - just clean, skin-supportive ingredients your body understands.

In our formulation, we use only truly natural ingredients such as grass-fed, pasture-raised Irish beef tallow, organic cocoa butter and castor oil, magnesium hydroxide, non-nano zinc oxide, kaolin clay and arrowroot powder that not only neutralise body odour but nourish the skin and prevent skin irritations.

Size: 50g (1.7 oz)

title: Tallow Body Cream: Velvet Dust - 1 pack
description:
A winter formula made to soften dry skin, support the skin barrier, and leave a clean, powdery scent on the skin.

The texture is rich but smooth, melts on contact, and absorbs without heaviness.

Key benefits:

  • Deep winter hydration
  • Helps calm dryness and irritation
  • Soft, smooth, non greasy finish
  • Powdery, refined winter scent
  • Safe for sensitive skin and family friendly

Scent profile:

Lavender for calm, vanilla for warmth, orris for a silky powdery finish, jasmine grandiflorum for gentle floral depth.

    What is tallow body cream?

    Tallow Body Cream is soft and silky, luxurious body cream, made with just a few ancestral ingredients, and nothing else.

    Soft to the touch, light on the skin, and deeply restorative beneath the surface, this cream was designed to feel like a daily ritual you never knew you needed. Its texture is smooth, almost mousse-like - rich without being heavy, nourishing without feeling oily. It will leave your skin feeling like your skin again. 

    Tallow Body Cream will disappear into your skin, leaving it deeply moisturised, subtly scented, and quietly radiant. Use it daily or sparingly - either way, a little goes a long way.

    This cream is created for people who:

    • Prefer fewer ingredients, but real ones
    • React to synthetic creams or overly complex products
    • Crave a skincare routine that feels grounding and nourishing
    • Want soft, hydrated skin without residue or shine

    Tallow Body Cream is formulated with no questionable ingredients usually found in skincare products. We use only truly natural ingredients: grass-fed tallow, cold-pressed organic golden jojoba oil, beeswax and pure essential oils (also available in unscented version).

    For most of human history, skincare wasn’t complicated. It was natural, intuitive, and rooted in the whole animal and plant. This cream is a return to that way - with a formula that respects both the body and the land.

    • Beef Tallow - From Irish grass-fed & finished cow raised on open pasture. Naturally high in skin-compatible fats and vitamins A, D, E, and K2.
    • Jojoba Oil - Closest to the skin’s own sebum. Balancing, lightweight, and non-pore-clogging.
    • Beeswax - Adds structure and natural preservation. Helps seal in moisture without suffocating the skin.
    • Essential Oils of Lavender, Vanilla, Orris and Jasmine Grandiflorum - Softly aromatic, never overpowering. A grounded, powdery warmth that lingers close to the skin.

    Size: 120ml - 4 oz

    If you are looking for unscented version with no added essential oils check out the Unscented Tallow Body Cream.

title: Tallow & Charcoal Cleansing Balm - 1 pack
description:
• Effective in cleaning and dissolving impurities without drying out the skin. 
  • Nourishes the skin and keeps the skin barrier intact
  • Detoxifies the skin and removes the buildup 
  • Can be used as a makeup remover or for regular skin cleaning 
  • Grass-fed & finished, pasture-raised Irish beef tallow, organic castor oil, activated charcoal and 100% pure essential oils
  • FREE of harsh chemicals commonly used in cleansing products.

Cleanse your skin just like our ancestors did - the tallow cleansing revolution has just landed!

The oil cleansing method is based on the fact that oil dissolves oil and that's why we formulated our Tallow & Charcoal Cleansing Balm. 

Beneficial fats and oils can penetrate deeply into the skin and can dissolve impurities and build up. Our tallow cleansing balm is expertly formulated to be effective in cleansing and dissolving impurities, has strong detoxifying qualities thanks to the charcoal and at the same time, it nourishes the skin and keeps the skin barrier intact.

Our Tallow & Charcoal Cleansing Balm is free of chemicals commonly used in cleansing products. These compounds can strip our skin of its protective oils.

We only use natural ingredients like grass-fed beef tallow, castor oil, activated charcoal and pure essential oils that not only help clean and purify the skin but also deliver nutrients and vitamins our skin needs.

Grass-fed Beef Tallow shares similar oils to our skin and that makes it ideal to use in cleaning balms. It will help to gently dissolve the buildup while providing nourishment and intense moisturisation to the skin. We source only premium 100% grass-fed beef tallow from local farms that is high in fatty acids and vitamins.

Organic Castor Oil comes from the beans of the Ricinus Communis plant and has a long history of being used for medicinal purposes including for skin health. Its many benefits make it one of the most beneficial oils for skin and hair use.

Castor oil is very effective for acne-prone skin or calming down breakouts. Castor is an astringent oil which means it’s extremely effective in cleansing, purifying pores and removing buildup. It also helps balance the sebum production.

Activated Charcoal has purifying and detoxifying properties. It absorbs the buildup and impurities leaving the skin visibly cleaner. Charcoal is extremely effective in unclogging the pores and can help calm breakouts. It will maintain skin healthy, clean and balanced.

Essential Oils of Manuka, Clary Sage and Rose Geranium offer synergistic benefits to the skin. They have clarifying properties, help to balance the sebum and calm the irritations.

• Soft and spreadable tallow cream formulated for oily and breakouts-prone skin
  • Helps balance sebum production and skin inflammation
  • Repairs and nourishes the skin while offering antioxidant protection with daily use
  • Lightweight and non-greasy 
  • Grass-Fed, Pasture-Raised Irish Beef Tallow, Cold Pressed Black Seed Oil, Black Seed Extract, Raw Honey
  • A unique blend of 100% pure essential oils of Chamomile, Clary Sage, and Rose Geranium 

The next generation of Tallow & Honey Cream is here!

Tallow & Black Seed Oil Clarifying Cream is a luxury soft cream created as a combination of the most powerful natural ingredients that soothe and calm the skin while still deeply hydrating it.

Made with grass-fed beef tallow, cold-pressed black seed oil and raw honey and further powered with highly concentrated black seed extract. This cream is formulated to nourish and support the skin barrier, help maintain balanced-looking skin, and protect against everyday environmental influences.

It’s non-greasy and lightweight and can be used both for oily and dry skin. 

Clarifying Cream is formulated with no questionable ingredients usually found in skincare products. We use only truly natural ingredients, grass-fed tallow, cold-pressed oils, raw honey and pure essential oils.

Grass-Fed & Finished, Pasture-Raised Irish Beef Tallow is the best moisturiser in the world. It restores and retains the skin's natural moisture and offers unprecedented benefits for the skin. It deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin.

Cold-pressed Black Seed Oil is one of the most potent oils in the world and has been used in skincare for thousands of years. It's a potent antioxidant. The main compound in black seed oil, Thymoquinone is the main reason why it's so potent and beneficial for our skin.

Thymoquinone, found in abundance in the oil, is known for its powerful antioxidant properties and is the key compound that is responsible for the potent properties of the oil. Black seed oil is ideal for breakouts-prone skin and as potent antioxidant, it also offers strong anti-ageing benefits and has excellent hydrating properties.

Black Seed Extract. In addition to oil, we have also added highly concentrated black seed extract that gives our cream real superpowers and allows us to unlock the maximum benefits of black seed oil. The extract contains more than 3% of Thymoquinone to make sure the skin gets all the benefits that this natural compound can offer. This makes the Clarifying Cream one of the most potent tallow creams out there.

Raw Unheated Honey has the most beneficial effect on the skin. It balances bacteria on the skin, improves acne, reduces inflammation and promotes skin healing.

Pure Essential Oils of Chamomile, Clary Sage and Rose Geranium offer synergistic benefits to the skin. They calm and repair skin on a cellular level.

Size: 60 ml (2 oz)

title: Ancestral Tanning Oil
description:
Our Tanning Oil is the one product to soak up all the benefits the sun offers, speed up the tanning process and gradually increase your ability to stay in the sun longer.

Inspired by ancient Greeks and Romans who knew how important the sun is for life and health, we formulated oil that will make your tanning even more effective and enjoyable.

Made from a blend of cold-pressed ancient oils and powered by beta carotene power house - carrot extract, our tanning oil will help you tan faster, and help your skin adjust to sun exposure easier by increasing melanin levels in the outer layer of your skin giving you golden tan while soaking up the sun rays.

Our tanning oil is completely natural, made with cold-pressed oils with no questionable ingredients usually found in commercial tanning products.

Here are some ingredients that you can find in our Tanning Oil.

Cold-Pressed Extra-Virgin Olive Oil has been used for thousands of years in sun care and to this day, half of the Mediterranean people will cover themselves in olive oil for tanning purposes.

Olive oil attracts and concentrates UV rays onto the skin, triggering melanocytes to produce more melanin. The more melanin, the deeper the tan. It contains antioxidants, including Vitamin E and polyphenols, which help keep the skin moisturized and protected.

Carrot Juice Extract is a true beta-carotene powerhouse. It is packed with vitamin A and E and, in combination with oils, help the skin produce more melanin and keeps it longer in the outer layers of the skin.

This helps to tan faster and keeps the tan for longer. It is a strong antioxidant rich in carotenoids giving the skin a nice bronzed look.

Argan Oil is precious and nourishing oil with many benefits for the skin. Abundant in vitamins A and E, antioxidants, fatty acids and linoleic acid. Nourishes and moisturises the skin while tocopherol from the Vitamin E in the oil helps to boost cell production.

Almond & Hazelnut Oils are oils originally used in the Mediterranean for hundreds of years for different purposes including skin care. They are nourishing and hydrating, rich in Vitamin E and antioxidants offering skin protection and hydration.

Vitamin E is a powerful antioxidant that can stop or reverse the damage that free radicals cause to cells in our skin. The body stores vitamin E in the skin in both the outer epidermis and the deeper dermis layers and applying it on the skin means higher protection and reduced inflammation. It acts as an additional boost to our oils and offers skin protection while tanning.

Our unique blend of skin-beneficial pure essential oils of Frankincense, Myrrh and Neroli will instantly transport you to the Mediterranean beaches.

  • Skin nourishing cold-pressed oils
  • Olive oil and carrot extract to boost the production of melanin
  • A unique blend of 100% pure essential oils
  • Handmade in Ireland in small batches

title: Tallow Sun Balm - 1 pack
description:
Ancestral Cosmetics Tallow Sun Balm is created for those moments in the sun that you just don’t want to miss out on.

Made with grass-fed beef tallow and 20% non-nano Zinc Oxide. Non-nano zinc oxide naturally acts as a physical barrier on the skin by reflecting and refracting UV rays from the skin. It's powered by antioxidants and beta carotenes from our blend of cold-press oils to even further nourish your skin.

Our Tallow Sun Balm is formulated without any chemical UV filters usually found in sun products. We use only truly natural ingredients, grass-fed tallow, cold-pressed oils and pure essential oils. It is natural, safe and glides perfectly on the skin. 

Non-nano Zinc Oxide acts as a physical barrier in sun care and because of its non-nano nature, it is not absorbed in the skin but it sits on the skin and reflects, refracts and to some extent, absorbs UV rays. Our formulation contains 20% Zinc Oxide.

Grass-Fed & Finished, Pasture-Raised Irish Beef Tallow aka the best moisturiser in the world. It restores and retains the skin's natural moisture and offers unprecedented benefits for the skin. It deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin.

Cocoa Butter is natural butter extracted from cacao beans growing on the cacao trees. It is one of the best natural ingredients to use in sun care being rich in Vitamin E which is a powerful antioxidant protecting the skin from oxidative damage. Due to its fatty acid content, it is deeply hydrating and it prevents the skin from drying out.

Olive Oil has been used for thousands of years in sun care. It contains antioxidants, including Vitamin E and polyphenols, which help keep the skin moisturized and protected.

Red Raspberry Seed Oil is known for its ability to naturally absorb UVA and UVC rays so it’s perfect to use in suncare. It has a high content of Vitamin E and Vitamin A and is rich in beta-carotene. It protects and prevents oxidative damage on the skin.

Sweet Almond Oil is a deeply moisturising oil packed with vitamins and antioxidants E and K to keep your skin protected and hydrated in the sun.

Vitamin E - our Tallow Sun Balm is additionally enriched with the powerful antioxidant Vitamin E to offer full-blown protection while in the sun. This powerful antioxidant can stop or reverse the damage free radicals cause to cells in our skin. The body stores Vitamin E in the skin in both the outer epidermis and the deeper dermis layers and applying it on the skin means higher protection and reduced inflammation.

Our unique blend of skin-beneficial pure essential oils of Frankincense, Myrrh and Neroli will instantly transport you to the Mediterranean beaches.

  • Grass-fed, pasture-raised Irish beef tallow, sourced locally from Irish farms
  • Cold-pressed carrier oils only 
  • 20% Non-nano Zinc oxide 
  • Natural unrefined beeswax
  • A unique blend of 100% pure essential oils 
  • Handmade in Ireland in small batches

description:
Completely edible and lickable dog balm for your best friend. We have created a completely safe, healthy and edible dog balm that can be used on your dog's nose, paws or any part of their body.

Nose - It will keep your dog's nose moisturised and prevent cracked or dry skin.

Paws - Designed to penetrate the thick skin on the paw pads to protect your dog's paws and make them soft.
